title_zh: 张学友：被誉为「歌神」的香港传奇歌手
title_en: Chinese Pop Songs (11/20): Jacky Cheung, Hong Kong's Legendary "God of Songs"
note_en: 对…来说 means "for..." or "as far as... is concerned" and sets the point of view from which the rest of the sentence is judged: 对很多人来说他的歌声代表了一个时代 "for many people, his voice stands for an era." English gets by with "for," but Chinese wraps the person in the frame 对 ... 来说 and puts it at the very start of the sentence.
